features: SEGMENT-LEADING PROCESSOR: Powered by the Dimensity 7100 5G chipset, the Nova 2 Pro 5G delivers fast and efficient performance for seamless multitasking.
IMPRESSIVE CAMERA SETUP: Features a 48MP IMX582 rear camera for stunning, detailed shots and a 13MP clear front camera for sharp, high-quality selfies.
CUSTOMISABLE BACK PANEL LIGHTS: Unique back panel lighting system lets you personalise notification and call alerts with colourful, eye-catching light indicators.
ANDROID 16 WITH nxtQ OS: Runs on Android 16 paired with nxtQ OS, offering a smooth, intuitive, and feature-rich user experience out of the box.
5G CONNECTIVITY: Built-in 5G support ensures ultra-fast network speeds, low latency, and a future-ready connected experience on compatible networks.
description: Introducing the Ai+ Nova 2 Pro 5G, a feature-packed smartphone designed to deliver a premium experience. At its core lies the segment-leading MediaTek Dimensity 7100 5G chipset, ensuring swift performance and seamless 5G connectivity for all your daily tasks and entertainment needs. Photography enthusiasts will appreciate the 48MP IMX582 rear camera that captures stunning, detailed shots, complemented by a 13MP clear front camera perfect for crisp selfies and video calls. The Nova 2 Pro 5G also boasts a unique customisable back panel with dynamic lights for calls and notifications, adding a personalised touch to your device. Running on Android 16 with the intuitive nxtQ OS, the phone offers a smooth, responsive, and user-friendly interface. Whether you are streaming, gaming, or staying connected, the Ai+ Nova 2 Pro 5G is built to keep up with your lifestyle. Its sleek design and elegant finish make it as stylish as it is powerful, making it a compelling choice for those seeking a capable and modern 5G smartphone.
